title: Park three data-protection items until real customer data exists?
bluf: Override of the prior-ruling gate: the gate matched only the word 'data'. Card hpsmpoc-hosted-demo-data-cleanup-1021 ruled c (leave two live-entered rows on the hosted demo) and hpsmpoc-hosted-preview-shows-no-sample-data-1011 ruled a (reset the demo's sample data); the others (Attio, NexusAI) are other projects. This card asks whether to park retention, audit-ledger storage and a schema-version bump until real customer data exists; I read HPSMPOC-100 ('when Kam rules K10'), -117 ('decide before any real customer data') and -180 ('leave 0.1.0 until the next planned re-issue') and the analysis repo's CLARIFICATIONS at origin main, and found no ruling on any of the three. The POC holds synthetic data only. Three items matter only if real data arrives: retention of client follow-up contact data (12 months proposed), tamper-evident audit storage on Azure SQL (today code rule plus DENY only), and a schema version bump that would change every ruleset hash. Recommend: defer all three, record the 12-month proposal, and revisit before any real data or the next ruleset re-issue. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-100, HPSMPOC-117, HPSMPOC-180
